notes: Company background: proprietary market-making platform, strict latency targets for live trading feeders.
Primary ask: guaranteed throughput for model endpoint family used in ticker-level inference + deterministic p95 latency during market open spikes.
Regional footprint: US East primary (us-east-1), EU West secondary (eu-west-1) — must support cross-region failover within 2 minutes.
Desired capacity model: reserved GPU pools per region with warm standby headroom, ability to burst to dedicated shared pool during rare peak windows.
Throughput targets: sustained 400-600 requests/sec for 256-token context; burst to 2k req/sec for 30s windows at market open.
Latency targets: p50 < 12ms, p95 < 35ms for 128-token responses; for 512-token inference p95 < 90ms. Customer expects SLOs mapped to GPU reservation tiers.
Failover headroom ask: 1.8x capacity to absorb traffic on region failover (customer prefers 2x), plus 10% headroom for autoscaler latency buffer.

Sizing guidance discussed: equivalent of 48 A100-class GPUs in us-east-1 reserved, 24 in eu-west-1 reserved, +30% cross-region standby reservation. Customer wants breakdown by AZ (spread across 3 AZs) for AZ-level outages.
Caching/batching notes: customer will use prefix caching for repeated session tokens; SE recommended aggressive prefix KV caching + sequence-aware batching to reduce token compute by ~22%.
SLA commercial asks: 99.95% uptime for Dedicated, credits tied to sustained p95 > SLA for >5 min windows, faster incident response (P1 within 15 min).
Security/compliance: requires SOC2 + ISO27001 attestation, support for customer-managed KMS, audit log forwarding to Splunk/Datadog, and data residency in US/EU for different datasets.
Quote drivers: reserved GPU pool count, cross-region replication, premium SLA, on-call >24/7 and runbook exercises.
